recipe.title: Ginger–sesame tofu bowls
recipe.description: Crisp-edged tofu, tender greens, a little sesame magic.
recipe.prepNote: Store the cooked base, main and vegetables in meal-size containers. Keep fresh herbs and uncooked finishing sauce separate; add after reheating.
recipe.rationale: Ginger and vinegar give the savoury sauce a bright edge. Bok choy or broccoli brings texture; spring onion is the fresh final note.
recipe.storageNote: Cool cooked portions promptly in shallow containers and refrigerate within 2 hours. Keep at 4°C or colder; use within 2–3 days or freeze. Reheat cooked leftovers to 74°C. The storage period starts at the original cooking time, not when a new dish is assembled.

servings.capacity: A 28 cm pan and a 3 litre saucepan; use the stated batches.

ingredients.preparation: drained, patted dry and cut into 2 cm cubes
dry weight; cook with package-specified water

steps.title: Set up your ingredients
steps.instruction: Wash and prepare the vegetables as listed. Pat the tofu dry so its surface can brown. A 28 cm pan and a 3 litre saucepan; use the stated batches.

steps.title: Cook the rice and prepare the sauce
steps.instruction: Cook the dry rice using the package water ratio and timing. Whisk soy sauce, ginger, rice vinegar, sesame oil and the listed sauce water in a small bowl.

steps.title: Brown the tofu
steps.instruction: Heat a large pan over medium-high heat. Divide half the oil across 2 batches. Cook the tofu for about 7–9 minutes per batch, turning until golden on several sides. Transfer to a clean plate; do not crowd the pan.

steps.title: Cook the vegetables
steps.instruction: Use the remaining oil. Stir-fry carrots and bok choy stems for 4–6 minutes. Add bok choy leaves and cook for 1–2 minutes more. For 3 portions, work in 2 batches as needed. Return the cooked tofu to the pan.

steps.title: Bring it together
steps.instruction: Pour in the sauce and toss for 1–2 minutes. Serve over rice and add sliced spring onion.

recipe.title: Smoky–lime tofu bowls
recipe.description: Warm spices, colourful vegetables, a bright squeeze of lime.
recipe.prepNote: Store the cooked base, main and vegetables in meal-size containers. Keep fresh herbs and uncooked finishing sauce separate; add after reheating.
recipe.rationale: Smoked paprika provides the warm base. Lime and fresh parsley make the finished dish feel brighter, without changing the main ingredient.
recipe.storageNote: Cool cooked portions promptly in shallow containers and refrigerate within 2 hours. Keep at 4°C or colder; use within 2–3 days or freeze. Reheat cooked leftovers to 74°C. The storage period starts at the original cooking time, not when a new dish is assembled.

steps.title: Set up your ingredients
steps.instruction: Wash and prepare the vegetables as listed. Pat the tofu dry so its surface can brown. A 28 cm pan and a 3 litre saucepan; use the stated batches.

steps.title: Cook the rice and prepare the sauce
steps.instruction: Cook the dry rice using the package water ratio and timing. Mix smoked paprika and cumin; keep the lime juice and parsley for finishing.

steps.title: Brown the tofu
steps.instruction: Heat a large pan over medium-high heat. Divide half the oil across 2 batches. Cook the tofu for about 7–9 minutes per batch, turning until golden on several sides. Transfer to a clean plate; do not crowd the pan.

steps.title: Cook the vegetables
steps.instruction: Use the remaining oil. Stir-fry the peppers and zucchini for 5–7 minutes; add paprika and cumin for the final 30 seconds. For 3 portions, work in 2 batches as needed. Return the cooked tofu to the pan.

steps.title: Bring it together
steps.instruction: Take the pan off the heat, add lime juice and the listed salt, and toss. Serve over rice with parsley.
